name: @cinatra-ai/org-write-kernel
description: The enforcement heart of the organization archive program (cinatra#1938, epic #1510 S2): the one capability predicate every org-scoped write must pass, runtime-unforgeable transaction-bound write permits, globally-ordered org advisory locks, and guarded adapters for both write worlds (callback-scoped drizzle transactions and fixed-query sync batches). Pure leaf: depends only on drizzle-orm's sql tag; db/tx handles are passed in, never imported.
